network_tab.network_desc:
Market sentiment propagates through the small-world network each round

Negative emotions spread 2x faster (negativity bias)

FOMO trigger: 3+ peer purchases → +25% purchase probability

Emotion affects willingness-to-pay: excited +30%, frustrated -50%

rl_tab.title: Economic Alignment RL — Strategy Adaptation
rl_tab.b2c_vs_smb: B2C consumers vs SMB business strategy differences
rl_tab.desc_full:
5-axis strategy vector (each agent learns independently):
- `price_sensitivity` — Price sensitivity
- `early_adopter` — Early adopter tendency
- `social_susceptibility` — Social influence susceptibility
- `loyalty` — Loyalty (low = easy churn)
- `risk_tolerance` — Risk tolerance
